$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. Loads automatically for any session started in
this repo — no per-surface toggling, no claude.ai connector settings, no
remembering. This is the structural fix for 'Open Brain wasn't connected'.
The access key is NEVER stored here. ${OPEN_BRAIN_KEY} is expanded from the
environment at load time. Set it in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored)
or export it in your shell — see CLAUDE.md § Open Brain.
If Claude reports this server failing to connect, probe it directly before
assuming it is a client problem:
A 401 {"error":"Invalid or missing access key"} means the key is stale —
the function is healthy and doing its own key check (verified 2026-07-27).
If 'http' fails to negotiate, try "type": "sse" — the endpoint is a Supabase
Edge Function and the transport it advertises may change.
